newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ansett, SIA, Air NZ announce alliance.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ansett, SIA, Air NZ announce alliance.

text.p: Singapore Airlines, Air New Zealand and Australian airline Ansett on Friday announced an alliance which includes code-sharing, joint purchasing, joint marketing and cargo operations.
The new alliance, described by the carrier as the largest in the Asia-Pacific region, would come into effect in a few months once government and regulatory approvals give the go-ahead.

"Subject to all necessary government approvals, cooperative activity by the partner airlines will include code-sharing on each other flights, network and scheduled integration, capacity planning, joint purchasing asrrangements, joint product
development, promotion and marketing, customer service, information technology application, and cargo operations," the airlines said in a joint statement.
